truth_evidence: Affected every release before 3.1.5; fixed in 3.1.5 (an indirect reference to str.format, e.g. via a filter, bypassed the sandboxing done in SandboxedEnvironment.call).
Fix commit 48b0687 'Merge commit from fork / fix format string vulnerability', in tag 3.1.5 and not in 3.1.4. https://github.com/pallets/jinja/commit/48b0687e05a5466a91cd5812d604fa37ad0943b4
Deleted: inspect_format_method and SandboxedEnvironment.format_string (the call-time check). Deleted functions count as vulnerable (they are the code the vulnerable versions ran).
SandboxedEnvironment.call: the inspect_format_method / format_string block is removed.
SandboxedEnvironment.getattr and getitem: now call wrap_str_format on the value so the check happens at attribute access instead of call time.
Entry points: the sandbox classes and the four public methods on the path.
